items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Played Algo those days? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, he was playing to Incline it. Clarinet.

ctx.x: Well, most of them now is dead, but I do remember that Edwin Washington, you know Washington. Oh yeah, he was there. Big Washington. Big Washington. Yeah, Big Washington.
Yes, he was playing to Incline it. Clarinet.
